name: Lean.Macro

source.code:
/--
A `macro` has type `Macro`, which is a `Syntax → MacroM Syntax`: it
receives an input syntax and is supposed to "expand" it into another piece of
syntax.
-/
abbrev Macro := Syntax → MacroM Syntax
